To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! titleEnglish: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
titleNative: 転生賢者の異世界ライフ ～第二の職業を得て、世界最強になりました～
synonyms: Tensei Kenja no Isekai Life: Dai-2 no Shokugyo wo Ete, Sekai Saikyou ni Narimashita
Mein Isekai-Leben – Mit der Hilfe von Schleimen zum mächtigsten Magier einer anderen Welt

Réincarné dans un autre monde
Моє життя в Ісекаї
synopsis: Whether at the office or at home, corporate drone Yuji Sano works all the time. So when his home PC flashes a message about him being summoned to another world, Yuji restarts his machine...only to find that he's inadvertently accepted the summons! Now in a fantasy world far removed from paperwork and computers, Yuji has just one thing on his mind: waking up from what he thinks is a dream and getting back to the mountain of work he left behind! But this other world has other plans for Yuji, who quickly discovers his Monster Tamer character class allows him to befriend slimes! And thanks to their number, those slimes help him absorb so much magical knowledge that he gains a second character class in the blink of an eye! How will Yuji wield his power now that he's the greatest sage the realm has ever known?! And what about all that paperwork?! (Source: Square Enix)

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)
